gen-fs-expose-gf-heebo: Expose packs its caps and lowercase almost shoulder to shoulder, a striking, tightly clipped display face with barely a pause between letters. Shrink the heading and that compression turns cramped, while Heebo stays legible.
gen-fs-expose-gf-hind-guntur: Tight, striking capitals lead in Expose, set against Hind Guntur's ruler-straight strokes, tall like stamped metal type. And paragraphs of Hind Guntur run steadily, its uniform line never swelling or fussing.
gen-fs-expose-gf-huninn: Modern in feel, Huninn has a drafting-pen outline, its lowercase rising close to cap height. And beneath Expose's compressed, striking headings, that steady line lays down a quieter floor.
gen-fs-expose-gf-michroma: Expose is striking and tightly compressed, with nearly no pause between letters. Michroma gives every letter a wide berth, spreading out exactly where Expose clenches, and that tension is the draw.
gen-fs-expose-gf-mochiy-pop-p-one: Expose delivers striking, refined headings with almost no pause between letters, tightly compressed. Mochiy Pop P One then spreads wide, its bent-pipe-cleaner lines and sizable lowercase loosening everything the heading squeezed.
gen-fs-expose-gf-mozilla-headline: Mozilla Headline brings big-bodied lowercase and a splayed c terminal, friendly and contemporary in tone. And under Expose's tight, striking display, paragraphs settle into an unhurried, approachable rhythm.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-kufi-arabic: Expose is striking and refined, its caps nearly touching the lowercase and its rhythm compressed to almost no pause. Noto Kufi Arabic reads clean, its open c inviting the eye onward.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans: Expose is striking and refined, with caps pressed tight to the lowercase, and it belongs big and short. Noto Sans fills most of its letter height with lowercase and keeps a wide-open c, quietly contemporary.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-adlam: Noto Sans Adlam reads clean and contemporary, curve endings kept well apart and its c, s and z tall and full. And Expose, compressed and striking, belongs up big and brief, where its tight rhythm can land.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-anatolian-hie: Expose is striking and refined, its caps hugging the lowercase with almost no pause between letters. Noto Sans Anatolian Hieroglyphs follows with outward-pointing terminals and a tall x-height, so paragraphs move smoothly.
